Sample.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/13] Means and standard deviations of the three groups on all depression measures at the assessment periods are presented in Table 1.

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/14] On the BDI, both the cognitive-behavioral group (Q_p = 5.28, p < .01) and the relaxation therapy group (Q_p = 6.02, p < .01) had a significantly lower mean score than the wait-list group.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/13] Based on the BDI scores, subjects in each condition fell within the moderate range of depression.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/5] BDI = Beck Depression Inventory; RADS = Reynolds Adolescent Depression Scale.
